The Rostas app

Your volunteers get an app. No app store, no password.

A volunteer taps the link in any Rostas email or text and adds Rostas to their home screen. From then on their roster, their availability and any request to fill in are one tap away. It's optional. Anyone who would rather not install it keeps getting emails and texts with a link.

  1. When someone can’t make it, Rostas asks the next person by app notification first. A notification costs nothing; a text is only sent if the app can’t reach them.

  2. Yes or no, done. Nobody has to ring the coordinator.

  3. Their dates and who they’re serving with. Can’t make it? One tap starts the search for a replacement.

  4. Volunteers tell you when they’re away, before the roster is built, not after. Tap cards to change availability.

When life gets in the way

Replacements just happen.

When someone can't make it, they say so in the app or from the link in their email. Rostas finds the next-best available volunteer and asks them, one person at a time. If they decline, it asks the next. The coordinator doesn't lift a finger.

  • smart_toyScoring picks the best match every time
  • notifications_activeApp notification first, a text with a link for anyone without the app
  • nightlightQuiet hours respected. Nothing is sent overnight, and you choose the hours.

How it works

The six-step roster cycle.

Every roster type — Sunday service, Music team, community meals, sports clubs, school PTA — follows the same six guided steps. Rostas runs each one in order so coordinators never have to remember what comes next.

Step 1
event_note

Set dates and roles

Add any extra dates for the season — like Christmas — then set how many volunteers each role needs.

Step 2
favorite

Role preferences

Invite volunteers to pick the roles they love. Or set preferences yourself — Rostas tracks both.

Step 3
mail

Ask availability

One tap sends availability emails to everyone. Volunteers answer in the app or from the link. A text nudges anyone who hasn't replied.

Step 4
apps

Build roster

Rostas assigns every role using availability, preferences, frequency caps, and household pairing.

Step 5
assignment_turned_in

Review

A traffic-light view shows filled, pending, and unfilled slots. Make manual swaps before notifying anyone.

Step 6
campaign

Notify

Volunteers get their roster by email and see it in the app. A reminder email goes three days before, then an app notification or a text the day before.

Everyone benefits

One tool. Two audiences. Both happier.

Most roster tools optimise for the coordinator. Rostas was designed for both sides of the page — the person assembling the roster and the volunteers being asked to serve.

Built for the hard parts

Designed around the moments coordinators dread.

Sunday morning at 7am, when a volunteer texts to say they can't make it. The week before a long weekend. The new family that just joined and doesn't yet know anyone.

swap_horiz

Automatic replacements

When a volunteer can't make it, Rostas asks the next-best person, one at a time, until someone says yes. People with the app get a notification. Everyone else gets a text with a link. No group-text chaos.

diversity_3

Households & the buddy system

Family members travel together — rostered on the same date by default. The buddy system pairs people up for mentoring new volunteers, or just because they prefer to serve alongside a friend.

tune

Frequency caps per volunteer

Set "max once a month" or "twice a quarter" per person per roster type. Rostas never over-rosters anyone.

insights

Insights

See before you build whether each role has enough people, and what would fix a shortfall: loosen someone's cap, bring someone back, or recruit.

traffic

Traffic-light review

Filled, Pending, Unfilled — at a glance. Edit any cell before a single notification goes out.

monitor_heart

System status and message log

Warnings in plain words, each with a button that takes you to the fix. A daily log shows who was sent what, how, and what they answered.

upload_file

Guided volunteer import

Bring your volunteer list in from any CSV or spreadsheet: upload, check the column matching, import.

edit_note

Your own wording

Edit every text, app notification and email Rostas sends, and preview what volunteers will receive.

savings

Text costs under control

Choose who gets the day-before reminder text. Volunteers with the app get a notification instead, which costs nothing.

Pricing

Free for 30 days. Then NZ$30 a month or NZ$299 a year.

No per-volunteer fees. No per-roster fees. Every feature from day one, including the volunteer app. Texts are prepaid: 12.5c each in New Zealand during the beta, in packs from NZ$31.25 for 250. Prices in other countries will differ. Credits don't expire, and app notifications are free.

science

Rostas is in beta, and there's no subscription charge during the beta. You pay only for the texts you send. We're setting up a small number of churches and community groups in New Zealand by hand. Join the beta and we'll be in touch. The prices below apply once signups open.

FAQ

Honest answers, before you ask.

There's no subscription charge while Rostas is in beta. You pay only for the texts you send, at 12.5c each. App notifications and emails are free. We'll tell you at least 30 days before the beta ends, and you won't be charged a subscription unless you then choose to subscribe.
A Google account for your organisation. Rostas runs in a Google Sheet that you own. Texts go through Rostas using prepaid credits, so there's no text account to set up. Volunteers are imported from any CSV or spreadsheet.
They need a phone or computer that can open a web link. Volunteers with a smartphone can install the Rostas app. Everyone else gets emails and texts with a link to tap. There's no password either way. If someone can't open links at all, their coordinator can record their answers for them.
No. It installs straight from the volunteer's own link, on Android and iPhone. No store account and no password.
Nothing changes for them. They keep getting emails and texts with a link, and can do everything from there.
No. It's included, and every app notification replaces a text you would otherwise pay for.
Rostas works through everyone eligible, then emails the coordinator. Manual replacement is one tap from the Roster Board, and the slot shows as unfilled.
It was built for a church, but the engine is roster-type-agnostic. We've designed it for any group running recurring volunteer rosters — sports clubs, community meals, school PTAs, charity drives.
Your volunteer list and rosters live in a Google Sheet in your organisation's own Google account. We don't hold a copy. Texts, app notifications and short links pass through Rostas's systems so they can be delivered. Our Privacy Policy lists exactly what.
New Zealand, by invitation while we're in beta. Australia to follow.
A full 30 days, with every feature unlocked. A card is required to start, but you won't be charged until the trial ends — cancel any time before then. We'll send a reminder a week before it does.
